meta.name: customize
meta.description: Add new capabilities or modify NanoClaw behavior. Use when user wants to add channels (Telegram, Slack, email input), change triggers, add integrations, modify the router, or make any other customizations. This is an interactive skill that asks questions to understand what the user wants.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为 NanoClaw 添加新通道或修改行为
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在定制 NanoClaw 的行为或集成新通道。
copy.tagline_en: Add new channels or modify NanoClaw behavior
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are customizing NanoClaw's behavior or integrating new channels.

howto.what: 装上后，它会先问你几个问题，弄清你想加什么功能或改哪部分行为，再在相应位置（如渠道、路由、配置）动手修改，并告诉你如何验证。
howto.when: 当你想加渠道（如 Telegram、Slack）、改触发词、调整路由，或做其他定制时触发。

say.text: 我想把 Telegram 加为输入渠道。
say.note: 会先问你几个问题再开始改。

say.text: 把 Slack 也接进来，但和 Telegram 分开。
say.note: 会确认是否共享 agent 组。

say.text: 给某个 agent 组加上 Gmail 工具。

howto.what_en: After installation, it will first ask you a few questions to understand what you want to add or change, then make changes in the right place (channels, routing, config) and tell you how to verify.
howto.when_en: It triggers when you want to add a channel (Telegram, Slack, etc.), change triggers, adjust routing, or make other customizations.

say_en.text: I want to add Telegram as an input channel.
say_en.note: It will ask a few questions first.

say_en.text: Add Slack too, but keep it separate from Telegram.
say_en.note: It will ask about sharing an agent group.

say_en.text: Add a Gmail tool for one agent group.
